title: Add dry-run and validate-only support for MCP writes
description:
Problem: MCP write-capable tools currently require callers to commit immediately when they want to test payloads, validate scope, or preview the effect of a write. That makes external automation harder to trust and increases the cost of safe iteration on task/page/proposal mutations.

Desired outcome: let write-capable MCP tools accept a common `dryRun` or `validateOnly` option that performs validation, authorization, and result preview without persisting changes.

Scope:
- In scope: define a consistent non-persisting write-preview contract for task/page/proposal-capable MCP tools.
- In scope: apply the option to the highest-value write tools first and document which tools support it.
- In scope: return useful diagnostics or preview envelopes rather than generic success text.
- Out of scope: full transaction simulation for every storage side effect in the first slice.

Validation:
- Focused MCP tests proving dry-run requests validate and preview without changing stored state.
- Docs updated with the shared option and any tool-specific limitations.

Confidence target: 87%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from MCP surface review because write-capable tools need a safer preview/validation mode before persistence.
